- graphify: Use for any question about a codebase, its architecture, file relationships, or project content — especially when graphify-out/ exists, where the question should be treated as a graphify query first. Turns any input (code, docs, papers, images, videos) into a persistent knowledge graph with god nodes, community detection, and query/path/explain tools.
- dataviz: Use this skill whenever you are about to create ANY chart, graph, plot, dashboard, or data visualization, in ANY output medium — an HTML or React artifact, inline SVG, plotting code in any library (matplotlib, plotly, d3, Recharts, …), an image/PNG you will render and upload, or a chart shared into Slack. Read it BEFORE writing the first line of chart code, choosing chart colors, building a stat tile / meter / KPI row, or laying out a dashboard. Produces visualizations that read as one system — elegant, accessible, consistent in light and dark — using a brand-neutral placeholder palette you swap for your own. Teaches a design-system-agnostic method: a form heuristic, a color formula with a runnable validator, mark specs, and interaction rules. A validated default palette is documented in `references/palette.md` — swap that file's values for your brand's. Here is my comprehensive report on where memo metadata is computed/derived from memo content in this repository.

---

## Summary of Findings

This repository (usememos/memos) derives memo metadata from content in several key locations, spanning the Go backend markdown service, the API service layer, an RSS feed generator, and a batch migration runner. There are two distinct categories of derived metadata:

### 1. Stored/Persisted Metadata (Payload Properties and Tags)

**Core extraction engine:**
- `/bench/home/work/internal/markdown/markdown.go` -- This is the central markdown `Service` interface and implementation. It defines and implements:
  - `ExtractAll(content []byte) (*ExtractedData, error)` (line 356) -- Single-pass extraction of tags, mentions, and properties from markdown content. This is the most efficient entry point used in production.
  - `ExtractProperties(content []byte) (*storepb.MemoPayload_Property, error)` (line 192) -- Extracts boolean property flags by walking the goldmark AST.
  - `ExtractTags(content []byte) ([]string, error)` (line 143) -- Extracts `#tag` references from content.
  - `GenerateSnippet(content []byte, maxLength int) (string, error)` (line 264) -- Generates a plain-text snippet by walking the AST, stripping formatting, skipping code blocks, and truncating at a word boundary.

**The properties extracted from content** (defined in `/bench/home/work/proto/store/memo.proto`, lines 15-21):
  - `has_link` -- whether the memo contains any links
  - `has_task_list` -- whether the memo contains task checkboxes
  - `has_code` -- whether the memo contains code blocks or code spans
  - `has_incomplete_tasks` -- whether the memo has unchecked task checkboxes
  - `title` -- text extracted from the first H1 heading, if present (line 211 in markdown.go)

**Where payload is rebuilt from content:**
- `/bench/home/work/server/runner/memopayload/runner.go` -- The `RebuildMemoPayload` function (line 74) calls `markdownService.ExtractAll()` and writes the resulting tags and properties into `memo.Payload.Tags` and `memo.Payload.Property`. The `RunOnce` method (line 27) batch-processes all memos to rebuild their payloads (used for migrations/upgrades).
- `/bench/home/work/server/router/api/v1/memo_service.go` -- `RebuildMemoPayload` is called on both `CreateMemo` (line 108) and `UpdateMemo` (line 447) whenever the content changes.

### 2. On-the-Fly / Output-Only Metadata (Snippet)

**Snippet generation:**
- `/bench/home/work/server/router/api/v1/memo_service_webhooks.go`, lines 83-89 -- `getMemoContentSnippet(content string)` calls `s.MarkdownService.GenerateSnippet([]byte(content), 64)` to produce a 64-character plain-text snippet. This is the central method all snippet consumers call.

**Where snippets are attached to API responses:**
- `/bench/home/work/server/router/api/v1/memo_service_converter.go`:
  - Line 76-80: `convertMemoFromStoreWithCreators` generates a snippet and sets `memoMessage.Snippet` on every Memo API response.
  - Lines 173-288: `batchConvertMemoRelations` generates snippets for related memos (when `includeSnippets` is true) and attaches them to `MemoRelation.Memo.Snippet` and `MemoRelation.RelatedMemo.Snippet`.
- `/bench/home/work/server/router/api/v1/memo_relation_service.go`, lines 154-173: Generates snippets for both sides of a memo relation.
- `/bench/home/work/server/router/api/v1/user_service_notifications.go`, lines 318-391: `memoNotificationSnippet` generates snippets for notification payloads (comment and mention notifications), populating `MemoSnippet` and `RelatedMemoSnippet`.

**The snippet field in proto:**
- `/bench/home/work/proto/api/v1/memo_service.proto`, line 266: `string snippet = 17` on the `Memo` message, marked `OUTPUT_ONLY`.
- `/bench/home/work/proto/api/v1/memo_service.proto`, line 444: `string snippet = 2` on the `MemoRelation.Memo` sub-message, also `OUTPUT_ONLY`.

### 3. RSS Feed Title/Description Generation

- `/bench/home/work/server/router/rss/rss.go`:
  - `generateItemTitle(content string)` (line 302) -- Extracts the first line of memo content, strips markdown heading syntax (`# `, `## `, etc.), and truncates to 100 characters at a word boundary. Falls back to "Memo" if empty.
  - `getRSSItemDescription(content string)` (line 338) -- Renders the full memo content to HTML via `s.MarkdownService.RenderHTML()` for RSS item descriptions.

### 4. Frontend Consumption of Derived Metadata

The frontend does not re-derive metadata from content; it consumes the server-computed fields:

- `/bench/home/work/web/src/types/proto/api/v1/memo_service_pb.ts`, line 190: `snippet: string` field on the Memo type.
- `/bench/home/work/web/src/components/MemoView/components/MemoSnippetLink.tsx` -- Renders the snippet as a link label for related memos.
- `/bench/home/work/web/src/components/MemoDetailSidebar/MemoDetailSidebar.tsx`, line 155 -- Uses `relatedMemo.snippet` for relation row display.
- `/bench/home/work/web/src/components/UserMemoMap/UserMemoMap.tsx`, line 154 -- Uses `memo.snippet` in map popup.
- `/bench/home/work/web/src/components/MemoView/components/MemoCommentListView.tsx`, line 45 -- Falls back to `comment.snippet || comment.content` for preview.
- `/bench/home/work/web/src/components/Inbox/MemoCommentMessage.tsx` and `MemoMentionMessage.tsx` -- Display `memoSnippet` and `relatedMemoSnippet` from notification payloads.
- `/bench/home/work/web/src/hooks/useMemoFilters.ts`, lines 73-77 -- Uses `property.hasLink`, `property.hasTaskList`, `property.hasCode` for client-side filtering.
- `/bench/home/work/web/src/components/PagedMemoList/memoCardHeight.ts` -- Estimates card height from `memo.content` length and attachment counts (for virtual scrolling), though this is a layout computation rather than metadata extraction.

### 5. The `Property` Conversion Layer

- `/bench/home/work/server/router/api/v1/memo_service_converter.go`, lines 315-326: `convertMemoPropertyFromStore` maps the stored proto `MemoPayload_Property` to the API-facing `Memo_Property`, including all five fields (`HasLink`, `HasTaskList`, `HasCode`, `HasIncompleteTasks`, `Title`).

---

### Key Files Summary

| File | Role |
|------|------|
| `/bench/home/work/internal/markdown/markdown.go` | Core metadata extraction engine (tags, properties, snippet, mentions) |
| `/bench/home/work/server/runner/memopayload/runner.go` | `RebuildMemoPayload` -- persists extracted tags + properties into memo payload |
| `/bench/home/work/server/router/api/v1/memo_service_webhooks.go` (lines 83-89) | `getMemoContentSnippet` -- 64-char snippet generator wrapper |
| `/bench/home/work/server/router/api/v1/memo_service_converter.go` | Attaches snippet + property to API responses |
| `/bench/home/work/server/router/api/v1/user_service_notifications.go` (lines 318-396) | Notification snippet generation |
| `/bench/home/work/server/router/rss/rss.go` (lines 302-344) | RSS title extraction and HTML description rendering |
| `/bench/home/work/proto/store/memo.proto` | Schema for persisted `MemoPayload.Property` (has_link, has_task_list, has_code, has_incomplete_tasks, title) |
| `/bench/home/work/proto/api/v1/memo_service.proto` (lines 265-279) | Schema for output-only `snippet` and `Property` on API Memo message |
| `/bench/home/work/server/router/api/v1/memo_service.go` | CreateMemo/UpdateMemo call `RebuildMemoPayload` on content changes |

content.text:
h14.

**Computation site:** `internal/markdown/markdown.go` — the `ExtractProperties` method (line 192) and `ExtractAll` method (line 356) walk the goldmark AST to compute properties; `GenerateSnippet` (line 264) produces a plain-text snippet. These are invoked via `memopayload.RebuildMemoPayload` in `server/runner/memopayload/runner.go:74`, which calls `ExtractAll` for a single-pass extraction.

**Triggers:**
1. **CreateMemo** — `server/router/api/v1/memo_service.go:108` calls `RebuildMemoPayload` before persisting a new memo.
2. **UpdateMemo** — `server/router/api/v1/memo_service.go:447` calls `RebuildMemoPayload` when the `content` field is in the update mask.
3. **Batch rebuild (migration/startup)** — `runner.go:27` (`RunOnce`) iterates all memos in batches and rebuilds every payload.

**Extracted properties** (defined in `proto/store/memo.proto`):
- `has_link` — whether the content contains any markdown links
- `has_task_list` — whether the content contains task checkboxes
- `has_code` — whether the content contains code blocks or code spans
- `has_incomplete_tasks` — whether any task checkboxes are unchecked
- `title` — text of the first H1 heading, if present
- `tags` — `#tag` references extracted from content (via `ExtractTags`)
- `snippet` — a truncated plain-text summary (generated on-the-fly during API response conversion in `memo_service_converter.go:76`, not persisted)
